title: Plan founder and key-person succession
summary: When the company becomes dependent on a founder or other person for decisions, relationships or critical access. A tested continuity and succession plan with lawful authority, alternate owners and protected access.
outcomes: A tested continuity and succession plan with lawful authority, alternate owners and protected access.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When the company becomes dependent on a founder or other person for decisions, relationships or critical access.

parts.title: Identify key-person dependencies
parts.guidance: Inventory critical decisions, customer relationships, technical knowledge, signing powers and system ownership concentrated in one person. Record the business impact of their absence without publishing credentials or personal details.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Agree emergency and long-term authority
parts.guidance: The board and counsel establish how replacement decisions, delegations and communications will work. Resolve governing-document restrictions and distinguish temporary cover from permanent appointment or ownership transfer.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Prepare handover and access-recovery instructions
parts.guidance: Write role-specific runbooks, contacts and evidence locations. Use the company access-recovery process and restricted vaults; the succession document should point to authorized access rather than contain raw secrets.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Exercise a realistic absence scenario
parts.guidance: Have designated alternates perform a tabletop handover and authorized access check. Record decisions they could not make, unavailable information and counterparty mandates needing updates.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Close gaps and schedule a review
parts.guidance: Assign remediation owners and verify the corrected runbooks with the alternates. Refresh the plan after financing, leadership or critical-system changes and retain the exercise record.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: A tested continuity and succession plan with lawful authority, alternate owners and protected access.
